 2026년 10월 20일(화) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Sports Photos [Photo] Grand slam Kim Do-yeong beams in dugout 
 입력 2026.10.20. 19:32 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 
 On the 20th at Jamsil Baseball Stadium in Songpa-gu, Seoul, Game 3 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO first round of the playoffs between the LG Twins and the KIA Tigers was held.
 Home team LG started Carrasco, and KIA started Shirakawa.
 With one out and the bases loaded in the top of the second, KIA's Kim Do-yeong hit a grand slam and is celebrating with teammates. 2026.10.20
